headerDisplay: GivHome brings local GivEnergy battery automation into Apple Home — calm, practical and built around Intelligent Octopus Go.

inverterSerial.title: Battery Serial Number
inverterSerial.description: Required. Find this in the GivEnergy app: Settings → Local Monitoring → Scan for your inverter. Example: CH2344G083.

maxPvKw.title: Maximum Solar Power (kW)
maxPvKw.description: Optional. Maximum PV/solar output used to scale the Solar tile. Leave blank or set to 0 if this battery system does not have solar PV. Example: 2.88 for a 2.88 kW array.

octopusAccountNumber.title: Octopus Account Number
octopusAccountNumber.description: For Intelligent Octopus Go smart dispatch windows. Usually starts with A-. Leave blank only if you want monitoring/manual control/off-peak scheduling without Octopus dispatch.

octopusApiKey.title: Octopus API Key
octopusApiKey.description: Find this in your Octopus Energy online account under Developer Settings / API access. Used only to read Intelligent Octopus Go dispatch windows; leave blank only if not using IOG dispatch.

targetSoc.title: Target Charge %
targetSoc.description: Default battery target for automatic and manual charge slots. Leave at 100 unless you intentionally want a lower target.

cheapStart.title: Off-Peak Start
cheapStart.description: Default Intelligent Octopus Go off-peak start time. Leave at 23:30 unless your tariff differs. Use HH:MM 24-hour format, for example 23:30.

cheapEnd.title: Off-Peak End
cheapEnd.description: Default Intelligent Octopus Go off-peak end time. Leave at 05:30 unless your tariff differs. Use HH:MM 24-hour format, for example 23:30.

graceMinutes.title: Grace Period
graceMinutes.description: After an Octopus smart dispatch ends, continue only until the end of the current half-hour period (:00 or :30). Leave at 30 for this behaviour.

name.title: Homebridge Platform Name
name.description: Advanced. Internal Homebridge platform display name. Leave as GivHome.

mqttUrl.title: MQTT URL
mqttUrl.description: Advanced. Local MQTT broker used by GivTCP telemetry. Leave unchanged for the standard GivHome appliance where host port 1884 maps to Mosquitto container port 1883. Existing non-appliance installs may use their own broker.

mqttUsername.title: MQTT Username
mqttUsername.description: Advanced. Only needed if your MQTT broker requires authentication.

mqttPassword.title: MQTT Password
mqttPassword.description: Advanced. Only needed if your MQTT broker requires authentication.

mqttRootTopic.title: MQTT Root Topic
mqttRootTopic.description: Advanced. Root MQTT topic published by GivTCP.

givTcpRestUrl.title: GivTCP Local Address
givTcpRestUrl.description: Advanced. Local GivTCP REST control endpoint. Leave unchanged unless GivTCP is running on another device. If you need to locate your inverter, use the GivEnergy app: Settings → Local Monitoring → Scan for your inverter.

octopusPollSeconds.title: Octopus Polling Seconds
octopusPollSeconds.description: Advanced. How often the plugin checks Octopus for updated smart charging windows.

slotToleranceMinutes.title: Manual Tile Tolerance
slotToleranceMinutes.description: Extra time allowed when checking whether manual charge or export slots are still active. Helps absorb inverter clock drift and telemetry delays.

powerActiveThreshold.title: Legacy Shared Power Active Threshold W
powerActiveThreshold.description: Legacy fallback only. If the new separate thresholds are unset, this value is used as their default. New installs should use the individual threshold controls below.

staleSeconds.title: Telemetry Stale Seconds
staleSeconds.description: How long MQTT telemetry can be silent before the inverter is shown as offline.

smartWindowsJson.title: Manual Smart Windows JSON
smartWindowsJson.description: Advanced fallback only. Optional extra cheap windows, e.g. [{"start":"13:30","end":"15:00"}].

inverterIp.title: Inverter IP Address
inverterIp.description: Required for new appliance setup. Find this in the same GivEnergy app scan result as the Battery Serial Number: Settings → Local Monitoring → Scan for your inverter. Example: 192.168.0.223.

chargePowerActiveThreshold.title: Battery Charging Threshold (Watts)
chargePowerActiveThreshold.description: Wattage threshold used to decide when the Battery Charging Light in Apple Home becomes active. Increase this value to ignore smaller or less interesting power changes. Set to 0 to disable this observation.

dischargePowerActiveThreshold.title: Battery Discharging Threshold (Watts)
dischargePowerActiveThreshold.description: Wattage threshold used to decide when the Battery Discharging Light in Apple Home becomes active. Increase this value to ignore smaller or less interesting power changes. Set to 0 to disable this observation.

importPowerActiveThreshold.title: Grid Import Threshold (Watts)
importPowerActiveThreshold.description: Wattage threshold used to decide when the Grid Import Light in Apple Home becomes active. Increase this value to ignore smaller or less interesting power changes. Set to 0 to disable this observation.

exportPowerActiveThreshold.title: Grid Export Threshold (Watts)
exportPowerActiveThreshold.description: Wattage threshold used to decide when the Grid Export Light in Apple Home becomes active. Increase this value to ignore smaller or less interesting power changes. Set to 0 to disable this observation.

exposeAdvancedTelemetry.title: Extra Indicators in Apple Home
exposeAdvancedTelemetry.description: Optional. Adds extra informational Lights to Apple Home for states such as Cheap Rate, Grace Period, Battery Charging, Battery Discharging, Grid Import, Grid Export, and Online. These are indicators, not controls.

enableEveEnergyHistory.title: Energy History in the Eve App
enableEveEnergyHistory.description: Optional. Creates Eve Solar History, Eve Import History, and Eve Export History accessories so the Eve app can show local energy graphs and trends. These history tiles are informational only; in Apple Home, we recommend setting them to Exclude from Home View.

enableExcessEnergyExport.title: Excess Energy Export
enableExcessEnergyExport.description: Optional. Lets GivHome export spare battery energy later in the evening while keeping enough charge for your home to reach the next cheap overnight window. Disabled by default.

batteryCapacityKwh.title: Battery Capacity (kWh)
batteryCapacityKwh.description: Nominal battery capacity used by Excess Energy Export and Battery Care Charging. Enter the usable size of your system as closely as practical.

excessExportStartTime.title: Evening Export Start Time
excessExportStartTime.description: Earliest time GivHome may begin evening export. Choose a time after normal cooking, hot water and evening household use, for example 19:30 or 20:00.

excessExportReserveSoc.title: Evening Reserve SOC (%)
excessExportReserveSoc.description: Minimum battery level to keep before the cheap overnight window. GivHome will not intentionally export below this reserve.

maxExportPowerKw.title: Max Export Power (kW)
maxExportPowerKw.description: Expected export/discharge power used to estimate how much energy a short evening export slot may release. Use a realistic value for your system.

excessExportSlotMinutes.title: Excess Export Slot Size (minutes)
excessExportSlotMinutes.description: How long each evening export attempt should run before GivHome checks again. 30 minutes is a sensible starting point.

excessExportMarginSoc.title: SOC Safety Margin (%)
excessExportMarginSoc.description: Extra battery percentage above the calculated reserve required before GivHome starts exporting. Higher values are more cautious.

serveOvernightLoadFromBattery.title: Serve Overnight Load From Battery
serveOvernightLoadFromBattery.description: Advanced. Leave off for most Intelligent Octopus Go homes. Off assumes household load after 23:30 can be served by cheap grid electricity rather than preserved battery.

smoothChargingEnabled.title: Battery Care Charging
smoothChargingEnabled.description: Optional. Enables Battery Care Charging during the main overnight cheap slot only. When there is enough time, GivHome can use a kinder local charge-rate percentage instead of always charging at the system maximum. Disabled by default.

maxBatteryChargePowerKw.title: Maximum Battery Charge Power (kW)
maxBatteryChargePowerKw.description: Required if Battery Care Charging is enabled. Enter your system's real maximum battery charge power, or the lower limit you deliberately want GivHome to treat as 100%. No default is assumed because systems vary.

smoothChargingWindowMinimumMinutes.title: Minimum Overnight Time Remaining (minutes)
smoothChargingWindowMinimumMinutes.description: Battery Care Charging only runs during the main overnight cheap slot when at least this much time remains. If there is not enough time to be gentle, GivHome uses standard charging.

smoothChargingMode.title: Battery Care Mode

oneOf.title: Gentle - kindest charging where time allows
Strong - more headroom to reach target

smoothChargingMode.description: Controls how cautious Battery Care Charging should be. Balanced is the recommended starting point.

form.title: Required Setup
form.description: Most users only need these details. The Battery Serial Number and Inverter IP Address are both shown in the GivEnergy app under Settings → Local Monitoring → Scan for your inverter.

form.title: Charging Behaviour
form.description: Defaults are set for Intelligent Octopus Go. Open only if you want to change target charge, off-peak times, or grace behaviour.

form.title: Battery Care Charging
form.description: Optional overnight-only battery-care charging. During the main cheap slot, GivHome can choose a kinder charge-rate percentage from SOC, target, battery capacity, time remaining and your configured maximum charge power. Extra IOG dispatches and short windows continue to use standard charging.

form.title: Excess Energy Export
form.description: Optional local evening export. GivHome can export spare battery energy after normal evening use while keeping enough reserve for the home to reach the next cheap overnight window. Disabled by default.

form.title: Personal Preference Settings
form.description: Optional settings for extra Apple Home tiles, Eve energy history, manual tile tolerance, and observation thresholds. Smart Window shows as ‘On’ when Intelligent Octopus smart charging is active. For cleaner Apple Home use, set non-daily GivHome tiles to Exclude from Home View.

form.title: Advanced Local Connection
form.description: MQTT, GivTCP, polling, and telemetry timeout settings. Leave unchanged for the standard local setup.
